_note: Curated PNG logos for homelab-drawio diagrams. PNG, not SVG: headless Draw.io export does not render SVG data URIs. Embed with image=data:image/png,<base64> (a COMMA, never ';base64,', which truncates the mxCell style). Prefer scripts/icon_style.py style <name> --role <role> over hand-rolling a data URI. Every icon here was fetched from the source URL, rasterised at 64px with rsvg-convert, and eyeballed at 24px before being catalogued.
_scope: Deployed platform components only. An icon must not assert something false: a box gets a logo only for the product it IS, not a product its label mentions.
_aliases_note: victorialogs and victoriatraces share the VictoriaMetrics mark (one company, one logo) - label the box with the product name and let the shared mark stand.
